# 1 Samuel Chapter 2 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **Book:** 1 Samuel | **Chapter:** 2

---

### Verse 1 — "horn" imagery
- **EMET:** "my-horn is-raised in-YHWH"
- **LOGOS:** "my horn is exalted in the LORD"
- **PNEUMA:** "The LORD has lifted me high"
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows LOGOS. The horn metaphor connects to "horn of his anointed" in v. 10. PNEUMA loses this literary thread.

### Verse 3 — "God of knowledges"
- **EMET:** "a God of knowledges" (Hebrew plural de'ot)
- **LOGOS:** "a God of knowledge"
- **PNEUMA:** "a God who knows everything"
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows LOGOS. EMET's plural is awkward; PNEUMA's paraphrase is too expansive.

### Verse 5 — "the hungry have ceased"
- **EMET:** "the hungry ones have ceased"
- **LOGOS:** "those who were hungry have ceased"
- **PNEUMA:** "those who were hungry hunger no more"
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA adopts PNEUMA's rendering, which correctly unpacks the elliptical Hebrew.

### Verse 9 — "feet" vs. "steps"
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "feet of his faithful ones"
- **PNEUMA:** "steps of His faithful ones"
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows EMET/LOGOS with "feet" (Hebrew raglei).

### Verse 10 — "adversaries" vs. "those who oppose"
- **EMET:** "His adversaries"
- **LOGOS:** "Those who contend with the LORD"
- **PNEUMA:** "Those who oppose the LORD"
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA adopts "those who oppose the LORD" for clarity.

### Verse 20 — "lent" vs. "dedicated"
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "lent to the LORD"
- **PNEUMA:** "dedicated to the LORD"
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows EMET/LOGOS. "Lent" preserves the sha'al wordplay on Samuel's name.

### Verse 21 — "visited" vs. "was gracious to"
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "visited"
- **PNEUMA:** "was gracious to"
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA uses "attended to" — capturing the purposeful divine intervention of paqad.

### Verse 31 — "arm" vs. "strength"
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "cut off your arm"
- **PNEUMA:** "cut short your strength"
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA uses "strength" — the metaphorical sense is clearer in divine speech.

### Verse 33 — "die as men" vs. "die in the prime of life"
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "shall die as men"
- **PNEUMA:** "will die in the prime of life"
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA adopts PNEUMA's reading, supported by the context of vv. 31-32.

### Verse 35 — "in my soul" vs. "in My mind"
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "in my soul"
- **PNEUMA:** "in My mind"
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows EMET/LOGOS with "in my soul" (Hebrew naphshi) for consistency.

— SOPHIA
